response.text:
A failure is a transition from state 1 (service accomplishment) to state 2 (service interruption), and a restoration is a transition from state 2 to state 1. 

Module reliability is a measure of continuous service accomplishment or the time to failure from a reference initial instant, and therefore the mean time to failure (MTTF) is a reliability measure.
